SELECT d.id, t.dict_name AS dict_name, d.dict_type AS dict_type, d.dict_label AS dict_label, d.dict_value AS dict_value, d.sort_order AS sort_order, d.status, d.remark, d.created_at AS created_at FROM sys_dict_data d INNER JOIN sys_dict_type t ON t.dict_type = d.dict_type
AND t.dict_name ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.dictName}, '%')
AND d.dict_label ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.dictLabel}, '%')
AND d.status = #{query.status}
ORDER BY d.dict_sort ASC, d.id DESC
